question: given a ONE-MONTH ranking, how long should the book hold it? Two constructions (hold band and cohort) x two selectors x two cost rates, graded against the beta-matched benchmark.
what_varies: the HOLDING RULE only. The prediction column is the frozen W3b stage vintage in both cases and no model is refitted; the signal's own forecast horizon stays 1 month throughout, so this is NOT a multi-horizon model comparison (A3 has that).

risk_free_leg.declared: 0.0 on the months that could not be built, and they are named above -- never silently zero-filled
risk_free_leg.source: learner.benchmark.cash() -- pinned FF daily RF, OFFLINE

hysteresis_availability_note: `evaluate.book` takes hold_k; `evaluate.overlapping_book` does not. The mandate's rule (top-50 in, out below rank 100) therefore exists only on the hold-band path and is reported there. Presenting a cohort book as 'held with hysteresis' would be a lever that silently did nothing.

family.definition: 2 selectors x (6 hold bands + 4 cohort lengths) x 2 cost rates

deflated_sharpe.null_sd_basis: analytic 1/sqrt(T-1) -- only 0 null draws, below the 64 floor
deflated_sharpe.reading: after 40 cells were looked at, the Sharpe a zero-edge search would be expected to produce is 0.138; this arm's is 0.151.

power.mde_reading: on the 20.9 years actually held, the smallest annual excess this arm could have shown at t = 2 is 6.80%/yr
power.power_basis: a pre-specified 3.0%/yr excess at this arm's own realised volatility -- NOT its observed Sharpe, which would make the flag equivalent to t >= 2
power.reading: t = 2.39 on 20.9 years; t = 2 would need 14.6 years at this Sharpe -- ENOUGH TAPE

pbo.reading: share of in-sample/out-of-sample partitions in which the in-sample champion finished BELOW the out-of-sample median. 0.5 is a coin flip.

scope_aware_verdict.scope: 251 months, 2004-01..2024-11, the $3m/day + $5 floored research panel, top-50 vw. The BEST cell of a family of 40 -- its unadjusted p is the minimum of 40 draws and the Holm column beside it is the number to quote.

horizon_answer.reading: `beats_the_no_hysteresis_monthly_control_by_pp` is the number that matters: it is what the holding rule bought over the book this repo already trades. A best cell that beats the control by a fraction of a point has answered the question NO. `hold_band_ladder_robustness` is the guard against the opposite error: a single winning rung is the maximum of a sweep, while a ladder in which EVERY rung beats the control is a curve.
